offlineProtection.explainerLead: Your dashboard or kitchen display (KDS) must be on and online while you serve.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen turns off, the device loses internet, or you switch to another website, offline protection takes over — it pauses ordering or turns auto-accept off, depending on what you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ Keep your dashboard or kitchen display (KDS) on and online while you serve, otherwise offline protection may take over.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection is now on.

To keep orders flowing, your screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, offline protection takes over in the mode you chose.

Make sure this device is set to “Screen on”.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Turn off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders still continue — customers can order without you seeing it. Only turn it off if your connection is reliable.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: This decides what happens to incoming orders when your device goes offline.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses connection, this stops orders coming in while you can’t see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this van loses connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online ordering
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers can’t order until you are online again.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is off, so customers can still order but nothing is confirmed automatically. You’ll confirm each one when you’re back online — and anything still waiting is rejected automatically after the time you chose, and the customer is emailed so they know.
kitchenCapacity.desc: The most items your kitchen can turn out at the same time, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s own batch size still applies.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all selected categories, so if you only want to sell up to 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. Your mains will still stay limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave it at the infinity symbol for no limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them, capacity can’t know how long items take to cook.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: Add a van in Settings › Truck settings to set your kitchen capacity.
kitchenCapacity.lead: How many items your kitchen can make, so customers can only pick pick-up times you can meet.
kitchenCapacity.sameForAll: Same kitchen capacity for all vans?
kitchenCapacity.confirmBody: All vans will use {van}’s kitchen capacity. Each van’s own numbers will be replaced.
kitchenCapacity.colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward total capacity. Cooked ones always count; tick the instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
kitchenCapacity.countsLocked: Cooked — always counts (its prep and batch set the pace)
kitchenCapacity.countsNoCap: Set a capacity to choose which categories will count
kitchenCapacity.countsUnavailable: Unavailable until the database is updated
kitchenCapacity.countsTick: Tick to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared per-window limit
kitchenCapacity.setCapacityFirst: Set a capacity to choose which categories will count.

kitchenCapacity.itemsAtATimeHelp: How many items your kitchen can cook at the same time
kitchenCapacity.instantNote: Instant items aren’t included in kitchen capacity — customers receive them right away.
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.label: Allow customers to cancel an order
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.sentence: Customers can cancel up to <select></select> before their pick-up time
settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Auto-accept of orders
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order is moved to the next available slot. It only confirms when there is capacity. Orders with a customer note (e.g. allergy) still need to be confirmed.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: Order-ready step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Show a “Mark ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen displays (KDS) are set separately, on each device. The customer is emailed whenever an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still turn it on or off for one event on its dashboard.
settingsCopy.buzzers.label: Do you hand out buzzers for pick-up?
settingsCopy.buzzers.help: Record which buzzer you gave each customer, so you know who to look for when their food is ready.
settingsCopy.buzzers.countLabel: How many buzzers do you have?
whereYouTrade.stepIntro: This sets your currency, prices, time zone and phone number format. The country can’t be changed afterwards, because it’s tied to your card payments.
whereYouTrade.countryGuessed: We guessed this from your location. Change it if it’s wrong.
whereYouTrade.countryLocked: Your country can no longer be changed
whereYouTrade.townQuestion: Town or city where you’re based
whereYouTrade.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the settings — please try again.
stockCopy.defaultScopeNote: Default for every event. To set a different amount for one event, change it on that event’s dashboard — events you’ve already set there keep their own amount.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.perDishBod: Review every dish and confirm its allergens. Customers see the tags on each dish, plus a summary allergen card taken from them.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.cardBody: Upload or paste a single allergen card (PDF, image or text), shown exactly as it is. The per-dish tags are hidden.

manageSettings.getApp.body: The kitchen app runs your service on a phone or tablet — and it’s the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal. Free with your account, on iPhone, iPad and Android.

manageSettings.schedule.title: Your schedule
manageSettings.schedule.autoDesc: Tell us where you post your schedule and we’ll check it for you, and we’ll send any events we find for you to approve. This must be your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageSettings.schedule.eitherWay: Whichever you choose, if we see your events listed somewhere else, we’ll still send them to you to approve. Nothing goes live until you confirm.
manageSettings.schedule.wherePost: Where do you post your schedule?

manageSettings.schedule.exclusionsHelp: These terms are automatically filtered out when your schedule is imported. Remove any that were added by mistake.
manageSettings.qr.title: QR code for ordering
manageSettings.qr.domainLive: This QR code now takes customers to <mono>{domain}</mono>. You never need to print a new one.
manageSettings.qr.domainNotLive: This QR code takes customers to your HatchGrab ordering page. If you set up your own web address later, the same QR code will take them there — you won’t need to print a new one.
manageSettings.qr.printHelp: Print or display this code so customers can scan it and pre-order. Put it at your truck’s counter, on your van, or share it online.
manageSettings.qr.noUrl: No order link yet — your truck’s page address isn’t set yet.
manageSettings.qr.brandedHelp: Your logo is in the middle of the QR code

manageSettings.qr.lockedTitle: Branded codes are off for your truck
manageSettings.qr.lockedBody: Branded codes are off for your truck. Your standard QR code works just the same for customers — the only difference is your logo in the middle.
